title: Reading Unreal C++
introduction: Unreal C++ is the C++ language used with engine-specific types, macros and naming conventions.
learningOutcomes: Recognise the basic structure of a C++ statement and function.
Identify common Unreal integer and floating-point types.
Apply Unreal naming conventions to simple declarations.

activities.question: Which declaration best follows Unreal conventions for a whole-number player score?
activities.explanation: int32 gives an explicitly sized signed integer, and PlayerScore follows Unreal's PascalCase naming style.

activities.question: A semicolon normally terminates a simple C++ statement.
activities.explanation: Declarations, assignments and function calls are simple statements and normally end with a semicolon.
